head_commit.message:
wp1266 r13 g1: fixture mktree truyen bytes (B14 Windows) + chot fixture B5

Finding P2 luot Windows 1 (H 802a566): _amb_cay_rong truyen str voi text=True
vao stdin cua git mktree; tren Windows LF thanh CRLF nen ten entry mang \r,
X2 cua t246 mat policy va ca B5 do (rc 0 thay vi 12 VUNG_LECH). Ma san pham
khong doi.

- _amb_cay_rong: input la bytes, khong text=True (cac helper stdin khac trong
  diff da dung bytes: _amb_cm_hong, hash-object o B5).
- t246: chot fixture X2 co dung khoa policy truoc khi goi bo kiem; dot bien gia
  lap CRLF lam ca do o chinh chot nay.
